name: crafthall-optimize-workspace
description: Source of Crafthall Optimize: the crafthall-optimize CLI and Claude Code plugin (apps/optimize) and its engine (libs/optimize-engine).

scripts.test: vitest run --config libs/optimize-engine/vitest.config.mts && vitest run --config apps/optimize/vitest.config.mts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config apps/optimize/vitest.e2e.config.mts
scripts.test:claude: npm run build && vitest run --config apps/optimize/vitest.claude.config.mts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
